channel.title: This Hour Has 22 Minutes
channel.desc: Tonight, on an all-new episode, Trump scopes out his land of dreams. This Hour Has 22 Minutes stars Aba Amuquandoh, Stacey McGunnigle, Trent McClellan, Chris Wilson and Mark Critch. In this episode we used a generative AI tool to help create images which are verbally identified as AI in the context of the sketch. When using the tool, a human was involved in final decision making to ensure it reflected the satire portrayed.
